enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +5: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +5 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Guidance of Shar: On Vorpal Melee Hit: Your target is blinded for 3 seconds.10% Chance On Being Hit: You are blinded for 1 second. Blindness immunity does not prevent this effect.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
